      "section": "Nonpassing BLOCKED exit and independent denominators",

      "rationale": "A trait exclusion alone cannot prove discovery is inert. The new interval and fail-loud controls close the former invisibility gap; N24 adds a successful ordinary-discovery case.",

Current Step/StepCycles paths show why cold resolver work must stay outside the cycle path.",
